title: The Life of Jesus
subtitle: A timeline from Bethlehem to the Ascension

scenes.title: The Life of Jesus
scenes.narration: From a manger in Bethlehem to an empty tomb in Jerusalem. Here is the life of Jesus, step by step.

scenes.title: Born in Bethlehem
scenes.quote: and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
scenes.narration: Sometime between six and four B.C., Jesus is born to Mary in Bethlehem, and laid in a manger, because there is no room in the inn.

scenes.title: Egypt, then Nazareth
scenes.quote: He shall be called a Nazarene.
scenes.narration: Warned in a dream, Joseph takes the family to Egypt. After King Herod dies, they settle in Nazareth, in Galilee.

scenes.title: In His Father's House
scenes.quote: wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
scenes.narration: At twelve, Jesus stays behind in the temple in Jerusalem, listening to the teachers and asking them questions.

scenes.title: Baptized in the Jordan
scenes.quote: This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
scenes.narration: At about thirty years of age, he is baptized by John in the Jordan River, and a voice from heaven speaks.

scenes.title: Tempted in the Wilderness
scenes.quote: Man shall not live by bread alone.
scenes.narration: Then for forty days he fasts in the wilderness, and answers every temptation with the word of God.

scenes.title: Ministry in Galilee
scenes.quote: Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
scenes.narration: He calls twelve disciples, teaches the Sermon on the Mount, heals the sick, and preaches the kingdom of God.

scenes.title: The Transfiguration
scenes.quote: and his face did shine as the sun.
scenes.narration: On a high mountain, Peter, James and John see him transfigured, his face shining like the sun.

scenes.title: Into Jerusalem
scenes.quote: Hosanna to the Son of David.
scenes.narration: In his final week, he rides into Jerusalem on a donkey, and the crowds spread branches on the road.

scenes.title: The Last Supper
scenes.quote: this do in remembrance of me.
scenes.narration: On Thursday night he shares bread and wine with his disciples, then prays in Gethsemane: not my will, but thine, be done.

scenes.title: Crucified
scenes.narration: On Friday he is crucified outside Jerusalem. His last words, in the Gospel of John: it is finished.

scenes.title: He Is Risen
scenes.quote: He is not here, but is risen.
scenes.narration: On the third day, the women find the tomb empty, and they are told: he is not here, but is risen.

scenes.title: The Ascension
scenes.quote: lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world.
scenes.narration: For forty days he appears to his followers. Then he is taken up into heaven, leaving a promise that still stands.
